scientific_question: Does fixed TALON mass-right improve objective task success over raw-logit baseline on public, action-discriminating benchmarks while exact SHADOW non-interference remains true?

benchmark_families.lock_rule: Pin repository or dataset revision, release date, exact task IDs, prompt template, scorer, and answer extractor before reserve generation.
Pin release/revision, contest date window, exact problem IDs, language, timeout, tests, and execution image before reserve generation.
Pin EvalPlus package, dataset release, task IDs, tests, execution image, and greedy pass@1 protocol.

phases.rule: Validate loading, prompting, answer extraction, scoring, sandboxing, provenance, and exact TMR/TMR+SHADOW token identity. Use public examples or development IDs only.

On development IDs only, execute all four deployable comparators from frozen prompts and seeds. Retain a family only if baseline success is strictly between 0.05 and 0.95 and at least one preregistered action-discordant pair exists. This phase may select families, never thresholds from reserve outcomes.

Write a signed machine-readable freeze containing source revisions, item IDs, dev/reserve split hashes, model/tokenizer revisions, operator/config hashes, prompt templates, scorers, seeds, decoding, checkpoint schedule, compute budget, endpoints, and stopping rules.
Open each disjoint reserve exactly once. Execute paired baseline and TMR plus TMR+SHADOW identity verification. Rescue arms remain observational unless separately frozen before the reserve.

endpoints.primary: Macro-average paired task-success difference, TALON mass-right minus baseline, across frozen primary benchmark families.
confirmatory: Exact McNemar test on discordant pass/fail pairs
Paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval over items
Exact TMR versus TMR+SHADOW generated-token identity

uplift_supported_if_all: The primary paired-difference estimate is positive
The two-sided 95% paired-bootstrap confidence interval excludes zero in the positive direction
No preregistered safety or contract endpoint is inferior beyond its frozen margin
At least 30 discordant baseline/TMR item pairs exist across primary families
claim_rule.otherwise: Report exact estimates as null, inconclusive, or negative; do not convert a safety pass or oracle co-win into an uplift claim.

compute_policy.decoding: Greedy unless a benchmark's canonical deterministic protocol requires otherwise; any exception is frozen before reserve.
